explication: Orion automates eligible Discord Quests through either a DevTools userscript or a Vencord plugin. The engine discovers and schedules quests, drives task-specific progress requests, and can claim rewards; the achievement path additionally authorizes the quest app, reports activity progress, and cleans up the grant. The README documents all five task types and the optional local relay for userscript achievement quests. Several engine internals are only partially excerpted, so the graph omits unverified call relationships rather than inferring them.
